title: Harvest carried close
slide_intent: Connect ingredients with a human gesture so food sourcing feels lived rather than abstract.
strategic_value: An ear of corn tucked into overalls can give Sweetgreen’s world a casual agricultural character.
demonstration: A cropped person wears a yellow top and pale overalls with corn and its leaves emerging from the pocket.
practical_value: Use clothing, crop and gesture to suggest a relationship with food without requiring a full portrait.

content_islands.name: Person and clothing
content_islands.spec: Crop the person closely to emphasize the yellow shirt and pale overalls.

content_islands.name: Corn
content_islands.spec: Keep the ear and leaves prominent against the pale fabric.

reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph joins workwear, warm sunlight and unprocessed corn.
